镜头开始非常轻微、平滑地向前推进，从全身构图过渡到 3/4 身近景。推进过程自然稳定，不要突然缩放，不要变形，不要相机抖动。 博主抬手轻扶耳边头发或耳饰，另一只手自然扶在腰侧。她的表情从普通微笑变得更自信、更有精神。画面上方出现一个简洁的电池图标，从零到电填满，下方有小字“FULL ENERGY”。

不要科幻 UI，不要粒子特效，不要 AI 变身。

竖屏 9:16，纯白摄影棚背景，高亮柔光，半身近景或 3/4 身构图。同一位明确成年的亚洲女性穿搭博主，
她做一个“满电准备营业”的自信姿势：一手轻扶耳饰或整理头发，另一手扶在腰侧，身体微微侧向镜头，肩颈打开，表情从慵懒变成明亮、自信、带一点俏皮笑意。画面上方是简洁的满电电池图标，电量格填满，旁边有小字“FULL ENERGY”或“READY”。干净时尚，不要科幻变身，不要粒子特效，不要夸张动漫滤镜。

竖屏 9:16，保持结构一致，白色极简 cosplay 穿搭信息页。顶部是大号黑体中文标题“MAI SHIRANUI”。

根据角色 Mai Shiranui from The King of Fighters 自动推导完整 cosplay 造型：保留该角色的经典红白配色、棕色高马尾、忍者格斗家气质、扇子道具、白色绳结与红色服装轮廓等可识别主题细节，但整体重新设计成优雅的海边度假造型，面料自然，细节精致，有真实褶皱和层次，避免廉价塑料感。

左侧是统一结构的黑色细线边框道具与服装清单，固定分为 3 个编号区域：
1 区：耳环、头部配饰
2 区：上身服装、手部配饰；
3 区：下身服装、鞋履。
每个单品为白底商品抠图，商品下方带“1x”数量标识，整体与其他角色保持相同 1 / 2 / 3 区排版。

画面右侧是同一位明确成年的亚洲女性博主全身站立。她穿完整的不知火舞海边 cosplay outfit：红色挂脖 V 领度假上衣，胸口有安全内衬，不露点；白色绳结装饰，红色轻薄围裙式长裙或开衩沙滩裙，腰部有白色流苏带，金色耳饰，红白手部护腕，红色高跟凉鞋，手里拿一把红白折扇。她一手轻举折扇，一手自然扶在腰侧，身体微微侧站，表情自信、热情、妩媚但克制，像穿搭博主展示完整 outfit。 纯白摄影棚背景，高亮柔光，干净商业棚拍，时尚杂志感排版。

将它的手指变成握拳状态

Vertical 9:16, keep the exact same structure, minimalist white cosplay outfit information page, generous white empty space at both the top and bottom, especially clear bottom breathing room so the layout feels more premium, elegant, artistic, and fashion-editorial. Pure white photography studio background, bright high-key soft lighting, realistic commercial fashion photography, luxury magazine styling, clean and refined.

The overall page has a slightly elevated editorial layout feeling, but the full-body character photo on the right uses a subtle low-angle fashion photography perspective, the camera slightly looking upward to elongate the legs and create a stronger model-like silhouette. The model is a clearly adult Asian female fashion blogger with a graceful hourglass / funnel-shaped body outline, open shoulders, defined waistline, long legs, realistic proportions, elegant posture, and confident presence.

At the top, a large bold black title reads: “BOA HANCOCK”. Leave obvious white breathing room above the title, below the title, and at the bottom of the whole composition. Do not let the shoes, item list, or character touch the bottom edge.

The left side is a unified black thin-line bordered outfit and accessory checklist, fixed into 3 numbered sections. Each section contains exactly 2 items only, no more than 2 product cutouts per section:
Section 1: earrings and hair / head accessory, exactly 2 items;
Section 2: upper-body clothing and one glove / arm accessory / signature prop, exactly 2 items;
Section 3: lower-body clothing and shoes, exactly 2 items.
Each item is shown as a clean white-background product cutout, with a small “1x” quantity label below each product. Keep the same 1 / 2 / 3 section layout, minimal, organized, spacious, high-end catalog style. Do not overcrowd the checklist, do not add extra items, keep only six product cutouts total.

Automatically reinterpret Boa Hancock from One Piece into a more fashionable, sexy, luxury empress-resort cosplay outfit. Preserve the recognizable character identity: very long black hair, regal empress aura, red / black / gold color palette, snake-inspired gold earrings, elegant queen-like confidence, Amazon Lily elegance, seductive but commanding beauty, and the iconic proud posture.

On the right side, the same clearly adult Asian female fashion blogger stands full-body, wearing a complete Boa Hancock-inspired high-fashion sexy outfit: a deep red satin halter gown with a plunging V neckline, sculpted waist, asymmetric high slit, black sheer silk outer robe with gold trim, snake-shaped gold earrings, gold arm cuff, slim gold waist chain, red waist sash, black-and-gold high-heel sandals, and subtle snake-scale embroidery along the fabric edges. The outfit should feel sensual, expensive, character-accurate, and fashion-forward, like a luxury resort couture reinterpretation of Boa Hancock rather than cheap cosplay.

Her pose is confident and dominant: body slightly turned toward the camera, one hand gently lifting the edge of the sheer black robe, the other hand resting near the waist, long hair falling smoothly behind her shoulders. Her expression is proud, glamorous, calm, and irresistibly confident, like a fashion blogger presenting a complete luxury outfit with empress energy.
